title: Delete the dead TextDisplayPreferences singleton; repoint the tests that exercise it onto CurrentFontSize/ShowNikudPref
rule: SM-7 (no global mutable singleton) + TQ-8 (test exercises the wrong code path)
why: TextDisplayPreferences.instance is a global mutable singleton that reads/writes the UNSCOPED legacy keys text_display_font_size / text_display_show_nikud directly, bypassing the per-profile-scoping design the rest of core/preferences/ implements. grep confirms zero references from lib/ outside its own file (text_display_screen.dart imports this file only for the FontSize enum; the real state flows through fontSizeProvider -> currentFontSizeProvider -> TextDisplayPreference, entirely outside this class). Yet it has a dedicated 184-line test file, and story_acceptance/epic_02_content_test.dart's 'AC: font size adjustable' test (plus text_display_screen_test.dart's setUp) exercise this dead class instead of the code the screen actually runs, so that acceptance test can pass while the real font-size/nikud feature is broken — undermining the make test-story-X.Y gate this project's own CLAUDE.md treats as the definition of done. It is also a live landmine: any future dev who greps 'setShowNikud' lands on this unscoped API first and, if they wire it back in, reintroduces cross-profile preference bleed on shared devices.
recommendation: Delete the TextDisplayPreferences class (keep the FontSize enum, which is genuinely used). Rewrite text_display_preferences_test.dart to test only the enum. Fix epic_02_content_test.dart's AC and text_display_screen_test.dart's setUp to go through currentFontSizeProvider/showNikudPrefProvider (or a ProviderContainer override) instead of the deleted singleton.
acceptance_criteria: epic_02_content_test.dart's 'AC: font size adjustable' test drives CurrentFontSize/currentFontSizeProvider (or the real screen) and would fail if that provider's persistence broke.

corrections: Secondary rule citation TQ-8 is a loose fit (that rule's literal text concerns bug-fix regression tests, not identifying that an existing test exercises the wrong code path); the finding stands fully on the SM-7 dead global-singleton violation, which is precisely and verifiably matched.

The "sites": 2 count undercounts by one -- a third exercise of the dead singleton exists at epic_02_content_test.dart:904-919 ("TextDisplayPreferences.showNikud defaults to true and persists"), and text_display_screen_test.dart:41 setUp is a fourth minor touch-point (harmless no-op but still worth folding into the fix). The recommendation already anticipates text_display_screen_test.dart's setUp needing a fix, so remediation scope is correct even though the evidence list under-cites it.
